page.layout: One scanned image showing the outside of a book binding: a stained, worn vellum or limp parchment cover with ties and a leather strap fastening at the right edge. No printed page or text block is visible.
page.notes: The scan shows the bound cover of the volume, not a printed page. The surface shows only stains, abrasions, and wear marks, and there is no printed text, running head, page number, catchword or signature to transcribe. The cover is blank as far as can be seen.
